meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Codex 设为主智能体,接替 Claude 做规划、调用工具并恢复历史会话。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望终端 AI 的规划与工具调度由 Codex 接管。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Codex to lead planning and tool calls in your terminal instead of Claude.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 多了一个可选的 Codex 后端:你可以把某个群组的执行引擎从 Claude 切到它。被切过去的组,规划、工具调用、历史记录都由 Codex 处理,OpenAI 凭证只放进保险库。
howto.when: 不会自动触发。须由操作者在主机上为该群组运行切换命令并重启它,或先把默认后端改成 Codex 再新建群组,Codex 才会接管。

say.text: 把 Codex 装好并完成 OpenAI 登录或 API key 认证。
say.note: 执行安装与鉴权,凭证存入 vault。

say.text: 帮我把群组 g-123 切到 Codex,然后重启它。
say.note: 该群组此后由 Codex 执行,Claude 不再处理。

say.text: 查一下 Codex 是否已接入;没接入就补上。
say.note: 重复执行安全,已装好会直接跳过。

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw gains an optional Codex backend. Switch a group to it and that group is run by Codex — planning, tools, history — while credentials live in a vault, and Claude no longer handles that group.
howto.when_en: No auto-trigger. Codex takes over only after an operator runs the switch command for a group and restarts it on the host, or sets codex as the default before creating new groups.

say_en.text: Install Codex and finish the OpenAI login or API-key auth.
say_en.note: Runs the install and stores credentials in the vault.

say_en.text: Switch group g-123 to Codex, then restart it.
say_en.note: That group is then run by Codex, not Claude.

say_en.text: Check whether Codex is wired in; add it if missing.
say_en.note: Safe to rerun; skips straight past an existing install.
